correctness.rationale: By the original quadrangle incidence condition, no three labels can collide. The collision locus decomposes into three disjoint clopen pieces indexed by disjoint pairings. For E12, normalize its two distinct vertices to 0 and 1 by a unique oriented similarity; the free line directions and fourth vertex give parameters (r,β,α), excluding α=0,β exactly when r=0. A continuous β-dependent angular homeomorphism identifies E12 with (0,π)×(C\{0,1,-1}), a three-circle wedge. E12∩E34 has two contractible chambers α<β and β<α, collared in each piece. The homotopy pushout of two connected three-circle wedges along two contractible components adds one circle, giving wedge^7 per pairing, H0=Z³ and H1=Z²¹. Euler characteristic per component (-2)+(-2)-2=-6 matches 1-7; it corroborates, not replaces, the full gluing proof.
